seo.lead: BIShare's online file transfer sends any file to any device in seconds — no account, no app for the recipient, and no size-gate tricks. Files are end-to-end encrypted in your browser before upload, links expire automatically after 24 hours, and on the same network you can skip the cloud entirely with Nearby or QR Beam.

0.b: Drag it into the box (up to 10 GB free). It is encrypted in your browser — the key never reaches our servers.

1.b: You get a link, a QR code, and a 6-character code. Send whichever is easiest — by chat, email, or just reading it out.

2.b: The recipient opens it in any browser on any device. One tap, decrypted locally, done. The link deletes itself after 24 hours.

0.q: Is this online file transfer really free?
0.a: Yes — sending and receiving are free up to 10 GB per transfer, with no account and no ads. Optional paid plans only add bigger limits and cloud storage.

1.q: How large can the file be?
1.a: Up to 10 GB per transfer on the free tier. Large uploads are resumable, so a dropped connection or page reload continues where it left off.

2.a: Yes. Files are encrypted end-to-end in your browser with AES-256-GCM before upload; the decryption key travels in the link fragment and never reaches our servers, so we only ever store ciphertext.

3.q: How long do transfer links last?
3.a: 24 hours, then the file is deleted automatically. You can also make a transfer one-time so it disappears right after the first download.

4.q: Does the recipient need an app or account?
4.a: No — they just open the link (or enter the 6-character code) in any browser on any device: iPhone, Android, Windows, Mac, or Linux.
